categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: A five-line helper addition in src/util/fs.h is strictly incidental support for wallet file staging rather than a general utilities change.
categories.rationale: Incidental filesystem helper addition supporting wallet migration does not warrant review from the utilities area.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies core wallet migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet corruption during legacy migration by staging SQLite writes and delaying original BerkeleyDB deletion until migration completes successfully. Mid-process crashes or filesystem errors previously left wallets in an inconsistent state requiring manual backup recovery.
